_evidence: Car record prefix (0x225 bytes) for esi and ebx of 0x0042a533 (and 0x0042a792's family), background random (fill bytes: +0x9a speed words, +0xcc flags and the 0x40dc8a lane words are plain operands). Word +0xe2 is the lateral position: ax = ebx.e2 - esi.e2 (- [0x603b98] when +0xcc bit 3) - [0x603b50], and the 'js / or ax,ax; jne' at 0x42a578 takes the zero-gap path only when these cancel exactly, which random words never did; so +0xe2 draws from a list of round positions (0, 0x100, 0x200, -0x100 repeated, plus 0x1234 and the extremes) and byte +0x9c (bit 1 selects 0x40dc8a instead of the e2 difference) is clear in half the picks. Every value is valid: 16-bit sub/imul/sar, and the only idiv (0x42a69b) divides diff^2/16 (dx >= 0) by c = 2*gap (16-bit) only when dx < |c >> 1|, so c != 0 and the quotient is below 2^15.
